name: Sarda Energy & Minerals Ltd
title: Sarda Energy & Minerals Ltd-$ - 504614 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Energy-led integrated miner: FY26 thermal generation up 84% to 4,155 MU and EBITDA INR2,025 crore, but Q4 EBITDA INR352 crore was hit by planned shutdowns, and the 600 MW IPP expansion slips to FY31 with capex unannounced.

utilisation.quote: the company achieved the highest ever generation and sale of thermal and hydro energy during the year

capex.quote: Board has approved the expansion of the iron ore pellet plant capacity at Raipur from 9 lakh tons to 20 lakh tons

triggers.label: Pellet capacity 9 → 20 lakh tons
triggers.quote: the Board has approved the expansion of the iron ore pellet plant capacity at Raipur from 9 lakh tons to 20 lakh tons

triggers.label: 600 MW IPP expansion slips to FY31
triggers.quote: by 2030-31, we'll see that project commissioning

triggers.label: Q4 steel realisation up 10–15% QoQ
triggers.quote: Steel prices, which had reached multi-year low earlier in this year, recovered sharply by around 10% to 15% during Q4FY26.

triggers.label: Management expects end-product prices to fall
triggers.quote: So, we think that prices of the end products might also reduce.

guidance.value: INR500-700 crore per year range; about INR700 crore in total over two years
guidance.quote: In the next two years, it will be in the range of about INR500 crores to INR700 crores.

guidance.value: about 400 crore units vs 375 crore in FY26
guidance.quote: maybe it should be in the range of 400 crores units. Sellable units I'm talking about
So, we think that prices of the end products might also reduce.
commissioning targeted before the end of FY27
By the end of June, it will come into operation.

prior_guidance_check.quote: the company not only surpassed its INR2,000 crores EBITDA guidance

red_flags.label: Q4 PAT up on shutdown-hit volumes
red_flags.quote: Steel production was temporarily affected due to the shutdown of one 30-megawatt captive power plant unit since December

red_flags.label: Management evasive on FY26 domestic coal volumes and SKS unit cost
red_flags.quote: That we shall work out and give offline, we can discuss it.

red_flags.label: Treasury share purchase in Godawari Power
red_flags.quote: That was part of normal treasury operations, nothing specific.

evasions.quote: we are selling very less coal in the market because most of the coal is captively consumed.
It's very difficult to predict in such a volatile market it's very difficult to predict the exact numbers.
That we shall work out and give offline, we can discuss it.
